claims.quote: Aphyosemion rectogoense is a killifish known only from the Batéké plateau region and surrounding area in southeastern Gabon.

Known only from the Batéké plateau region and surrounding area in southeastern Gabon where it's been recorded from the Léconi-Djouya and upper Mpassa rivers, these forming a portion of the much larger Ogooué basin.
